text:
Maya: Heads up — weird crowd at Pier 3 this morning, looked like a mini pop-up with free espresso? Took forever to get on the 8:20 ferry.
commute-bot: SF FERRY: Boarding delays ~25-40m at Pier 3 due to increased passenger volume. Expect backups at terminal entrances.
Ravi: Yep, espresso line doubled back onto the sidewalk. 8:20 turned into 9:00. Worth it though, coffee was solid. :coffee: :ok_hand:
Sofia: Meanwhile, my bike chain ate a puddle at 3rd & Brannan, so I was a soggy mess. Pro tip: bring a plastic grocery bag for shoes.
Ben: Lost my beanie to a gust on the bridge path. If anyone sees a faded red knit hat with a tiny pom, it's mine. :sob:
Maya: @Ben lol I feel for you. Also garage FYI: lower level sensor is tripping when it floods, got a note from security. Avoid spot B12.
commute-bot: MUNI: 8X and 22 delayed due to signal trouble near Mission.
Ravi: If anyone's in the office kitchen, I left a spare pair of shoe covers and a paper towel roll labeled "for mud emergencies".
Sofia: :raised_hands: on the shoe covers, might need them at lunch.
Ben: :thumbsup: will check for my hat later.
Maya: Small plan — meet at the big table at 12 for a "mud debrief" (aka trade tips/coffee). Short and silly. React with :handshake: if you want in.
Ravi: :handshake:
Sofia: :handshake:
commute-bot: NOTE: Ferry volume expected to normalize by 10:15. Ops monitoring.
Maya: Alright team, stay dry and watch for rogue coffee lines.
